title: Truncated Rademacher sum limit
statement: For each real threshold $t$, the expectation over a uniformly random sign vector of dimension $m+1$ of the normalized Rademacher sum multiplied by the indicator that the sum exceeds $t$ converges, as $m\to\infty$, to the standard Gaussian density at $t$.
